items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: the contractor was Sandy Block, and I never got called again for another Perex Parado date.

ctx.x: So then what happens, though, I did an album with him after that, one of the tunes was in it was "Why Wait?" which was a big hit again, but I made this album and it changed contracts -- the contractor was Sandy Block, and I never got called again for another Perex Parado date.
Yeah. But you moved on to Mercury, and I know you were really ...
